projectSummary: A measurement-validity qualifier: muscle volume and anatomical cross-sectional area are different quantities and the choice of assessment can change the size-strength relationship. This is why tier-1 estimates in this slice are not pooled across measurement types.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; used for a qualifier only, never for an estimate.

study.population: The study investigated whether pectoralis major muscle size calculated from a reduced number of MRI slices, rather than all slices, maintains a similar muscle size-strength relationship with bilateral maximal dynamic and isometric bench press contractions.

title: Muscle volume vs. anatomical cross-sectional area: Different muscle assessment does not affect the muscle size-strength relationship.
